roleHints.owner: Full control, including deleting the workspace
roleHints.admin: Manage members, settings and all content
roleHints.member: Create and edit boards, tasks and comments

invite.title: Invite to {{workspace}}
invite.description: They'll receive an email with a link to join. Invitations expire after the number of days set in Settings → Access.
invite.linkHint: If the email does not arrive, send this link yourself. Anyone with the link can join with this address.

confirmRemove.title: Remove {{name}}?
confirmRemove.body: They will immediately lose access to this workspace and its boards.

confirmLeave.title: Leave {{workspace}}?
confirmLeave.body: You'll lose access until someone invites you again.
